0.0: Yes, I am Hella. After I lost my mother, I became Spiruna's assistant to acquire greater magical powers.
0.1: Elma is really worried about me, is she? Can you do me a favor?

yes.0: Give this Pendant to Elma. Tell her I'm doing fine and I'll return home when I finish my magic studies.

no.0: Now's not a good time? If you say so.

1.0: This is my master's Pendant! You found Hella, didn't you? Is she doing okay? Oh, this is such a relief.

yes.0: This means I have to keep the house extra clean until she returns! Thank you!

npc.0: Give this Pendant to Elma the Housekeeper in Orbis Park. She will be quite relieved to see it.

lost.0: Take the Pendant. Give this to Elma.

QuestInfo.name: Hella is Finally Found
QuestInfo.1: Hella asked you to give a pendant to Elma. You should return to Orbis and tell Elma about this.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Elma the pendant you received from Hella.
QuestInfo.summary: Give Hella's Pendant to Elma the Housekeeper in Orbis Park.
QuestInfo.0: Hella was right here?! Tell her that Elma is worried about her.
